description: Where each committed DTD source came from. Each was copied from Qualys's published XML/DTD reference by a script that only drops the PDF's page headers and page numbers; nothing is typed. These are the DTDs the reference shows for the /api/2.0 paths; the 6.0 and 4.0 outputs are expected to be supersets, and the drift check compares them when a served DTD is in hand (req-qualys-drift-ci-4).
